watch.name: restaurant-budget-500
watch.nl_query: Let me know when I've spent more than £500 on restaurants in the current calendar month.

nodes.comment: Plaid is the only transactions table carrying a category. 'updated' matters: a pending row is revised in place when it posts.
One persistent cell per month; rising edge per month key gives at most one fire per month with no cooldown node.
nodes.query: SELECT sum(amount) > 500 AS fires, sum(amount) AS total FROM plaid_transactions WHERE category LIKE '%Restaurants%' AND date_trunc('month', date) = $key.month
